raised: Psagot shows 'אין נתון' (no data) in the account list but is still called the cheapest, which is confusing
Psagot's ad says no management fees, but the fee list shows custody and quarterly fees, so the real cost is unclear
The page shows 10 years, not the 30 the reader plans, and they don't know if the winner would stay the same
The 'אינטראקטיב · שער הדולר 3.16' line names Interactive, though the reader never chose it
The cost legend (החשבון / הקרן / המדינה) has too many cost types and is confusing
The fund list is a wall of codes and tags
The currency-hedging (נטרול מט"ח) section is unclear and feels like a topic for experts
The single grey tall bar in 'מתחילים מבחירה אחת' says nothing
The three alternative tables repeat the account ranking
The 'מול המדד' column with plus and minus percentages isn't understood
Most Israeli funds show 'אין מחיר כאן' (no price here) with no explanation
Terms like צוברת vs מחלקת דיבידנד, קרן מחקה vs קרן סל, and (4D)/(4A) aren't understood
Terms like W-8BEN, US estate tax, custody fees and tax on currency change aren't understood
The reader doesn't understand why tax is the biggest cost or why it differs between options
The page doesn't say what to do next: how to open an account or set up an automatic monthly deposit
There is no plain explanation of terms on hover
There is no simple yes or no on whether the advertised Psagot price is real
There is no minimum deposit amount shown
The reader would drop the graph in 'מה הכי משנה' because the table is enough

problems.why: The report never complains about the '(מותג של MEXEM LTD)' parenthesis cluttering the account name; its only remark on that area is confusion about why Interactive is named at all, which is a different problem.
